nodes.label: Mandate valid_until Clamps
nodes.rationale: valid_until is ignored for one_time (always clamped to 7 days); recurring horizons are yearly 5y, monthly 2y, weekly 1y — horizon limits are imposed per frequency so a standing permission cannot outlive a sensible term for its cadence.

nodes.label: Pricing Currency Independence
nodes.rationale: The session currency is the pricing currency and is independent of the card issuing country or the merchant's country — the card network settles cross-currency conversion, so merchants never need to re-denominate.

nodes.label: Legal Mandate State Transitions
nodes.rationale: Only legal transitions are allowed (pause from active, resume from paused, cancel from active/paused); anything else returns 409 MANDATE_INVALID_TRANSITION. Cancel is terminal and local to Prava — it revokes authorization so no further charges can be minted, but past charges are unaffected.

nodes.label: One-Time Mandate Consumption on APPROVED
nodes.rationale: Reporting a one-time mandate charge as APPROVED moves the mandate to consumed (it cannot be reused), while recurring mandates stay active for future charges — the settlement report is what advances the mandate's lifecycle.

nodes.label: Always Report the Checkout Outcome
nodes.rationale: The outcome must always be reported after checkout execution (report DECLINED if a payment token was used but checkout failed) so transaction records and the card network stay in sync.

nodes.label: Lazy Mandate Expiry Check
nodes.rationale: Prava performs a lazy mandate expiry check on every payment-result request rather than eagerly — expired mandates are reflected in the status when read.

nodes.label: Non-Sensitive Card Metadata Only
nodes.rationale: Only non-sensitive card metadata is returned — full PANs are never exposed; only last 4, masked PAN, brand, expiry, and status.

nodes.label: Immediate, Irreversible Revocation
nodes.rationale: Revocation is immediate and cannot be undone; a revoked session can no longer collect a card, produce credentials, or be used by SDK operations, and any in-progress intent registration fails.

nodes.label: Sandbox vs Production Behavioral Differences
nodes.rationale: In sandbox no real money moves, the secure surface is served from sandbox.collect.prava.space, passkeys use real WebAuthn prompts, sessions keep the same 15-minute expiry, and only sk_test_*/pk_test_* keys work on the sandbox host.
